title: 第5章 带着收获回家
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“阿华，你去什么地方了，我们到处找不到你。”

    荣华一出现，在树林外面找人的另一位妇人便急匆匆跑上来。

    她看到荣华完好无损，松了一口气，抓着人连忙往外走，“官差他们说还有半个时辰出发，我到处找不到你，你去哪里了？”

    荣华顺从地跟着往外走，随便扯了一个理由，“不小心迷路了，我们回去说。”

    她虽然压低了声音，但还是藏不住一丝喜意，更别提面前之人还是多年的手帕交以及妯娌。

    谢锦韵顿时明白这是有事情发生，讶然看向她。

    一刻钟不见，多年的好友和妯娌好像变了个人。

    方还一脸菜色地去树林里找野菜，可这会儿脸上的喜意怎么都藏不住。

    她和荣华从小就认识，两家父母也是知根知底，属于那种她屁股一撅便知道要干什么的关系。

    即使故意遮掩，可她还是看出来了。

    谢锦韵立马敛了心神，拖着荣华走得更快了。

    不一会儿，两人回到了树林附近的驿站。

    一群流放的犯人三三两两坐着，在驿站外面休息，而押送她们的官差则在驿站内补充粮草。

    眼见荣华和谢锦韵回来，单独坐在一起的人群里，一个衣衫褴褛的男人火速跑了过来。

    “阿华，弟妹，你们去哪里了？这么久都不回来？”

    荣华望了下远处好奇看过来的一群人，对男人嘘了一声，示意过去说。

    明远征不明所以，但还是老实闭上嘴。

    三人回到队伍，荣华和谢锦韵被一大家子给围住，询问两人干什么去了，怎么才回来，是不是遇到危险之类的。

    荣华早已想好说法，故意加大了音量，一一说了她们的去向。

    还说之所以这么晚回来，是因为在树林里看到一只野兔，她想试试看能不能抓住，结果却让野兔跑了。

    她一说完，落在她背上的目光才散去。

    对面一群犯人中，有两三个人急忙向官差说要去方便，实际一转身，却顺着荣华回来的路线离去。

    守着大家的官差也没问，确保离去的人还在视线范围，就扭过头继续和同伴吃干粮。

    等到没有任何视线落在荣华这边，她才吐出一口浊气，看向围着她的一大家子。

    “娘、夫君、二弟、三弟、二弟妹、三弟妹，还有孩子们，接下来我说的话你们一定要认真听，不能尖叫，不能惊讶，也不能出声，明白没？”

    她扫过家人们的脸庞，特别是几个年幼的孩子，都仔细叮嘱了一番。

    “大嫂，怎么了？发生什么事情了？”
content_en:
"Ahua, where have you gone? We can't find you anywhere."

    As soon as Rong Hua appeared, another woman who was looking for someone outside the woods hurried up.

    Seeing that Ronghua was intact, she breathed a sigh of relief, grabbed the man and walked out quickly, "The officials said they would leave in half an hour, but I can't find you anywhere. Where have you been?"

    Ronghua followed him out obediently and gave a random excuse, "I accidentally got lost. Let's talk about it when we go back."

    Although she lowered her voice, she still couldn't hide a hint of joy, not to mention that the person in front of her was her long-time handkerchief lover and her sister-in-law.

    Xie Jinyun immediately understood that something was going on and looked at her in surprise.

    After not seeing each other for a quarter of an hour, my long-time friend and sister-in-law seemed to have become a different person.

    Fang still went to the woods to look for wild vegetables with a look on his face, but now he couldn't hide the joy on his face.

    She and Rong Hua have known each other since they were young, and their parents know each other well. It's the kind of relationship where she knows what to do as soon as she sticks her butt out.

    Even though she deliberately concealed it, she still saw it.

    Xie Jinyun immediately calmed down and dragged Ronghua away faster.

    After a while, the two returned to the inn near the woods.

    A group of exiled prisoners were sitting in twos and threes, resting outside the inn, while the officers escorting them were replenishing food and grass inside the inn.

    Seeing Ronghua and Xie Jinyun coming back, a man in ragged clothes ran over quickly among the people sitting alone.

    "Ahua, brothers and sisters, where have you been? You haven't come back for so long?"

    Ronghua looked at the group of people who were looking curiously in the distance, booed the man, and motioned to come over.

    Ming Yuanzheng didn't know why, but he still kept his mouth shut.

    The three of them returned to the team. Rong Hua and Xie Jinyun were surrounded by a large family, asking them what they were doing, why they came back, and whether they were in danger.

    Ronghua had already thought of his explanation, and deliberately increased his volume, telling them where they were going one by one.

    She also said that the reason why she came back so late was because she saw a hare in the woods and wanted to see if she could catch it, but the hare ran away.

    As soon as she finished speaking, the eyes on her back disappeared.

    Among the group of prisoners opposite, two or three people hurriedly told the official that they were going there for convenience, but in fact they turned around and left along the route Ronghua took back.

    The officer who was guarding everyone didn't ask any questions. He made sure that the departing people were still within sight, then turned around and continued eating solid food with his companions.

    When no one looked at Rong Hua, she let out a breath and looked at the family surrounding her.

    "Mother, husband, second brother, third brother, second sister-in-law, third brother-in-law, and children, you must listen carefully to what I say next. You cannot scream, be surprised, or make any sound. Do you understand?"

    She glanced at the faces of the family members, especially the young children, and gave them careful instructions.

    "Sister-in-law, what's wrong? What happened?"
title_en: Chapter 5 Go home with the harvest
